verdict.rationale: Twenty documents an app framework where developers build apps that can be published for the community or kept private, which implies a distribution channel. It also lists a Zapier connection and built-in Google Workspace/Microsoft 365 sync. However, nothing shows an ops-facing marketplace where prebuilt Slack, support-desk, marketing or data-warehouse integrations are browsed and installed; Slack alerts are only an example built through workflows. Missing for 10: a documented app marketplace with an install flow, prebuilt first-party or community integrations in the named categories, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
